explanation: Job 2's incorrect upstream_rank values are downstream symptoms of a bad upstream handoff. The upstream assemble_provenance function writes each provenance row's record_id from source_id instead of preserving the demand record_id, producing evidence_sources with record_id values s01-s08. Job 2 then correctly attempts to join evidence ranks by record_id against coverage rows n06-r01 through n06-r08, so no ranks match and all observed upstream_rank values become 0. This violates the requirement to preserve record identity and upstream provenance order.
cited_evidence: Job 2 input evidence_sources contains record_id values s01, s02, ... s08 while needs/coverage use record_id values n06-r01, n06-r02, ... n06-r08.
prioritize source builds rank_by_record_id from evidence.get('record_id', '') and then looks up rank_by_record_id.get(coverage.get('record_id', ''), 0).
Observed Job-2 priorities show upstream_rank: 0 for every record, demonstrating the provenance join failed.
